FolderInfo.description:
Canonical wire shape for a folder. Used by single-folder GETs, create
responses, list rows, and subfolder list rows.

is_orphaned.description:
True when `maybe_parent_folder_token` is set but the referenced
parent row is missing or soft-deleted.

last_media_thumbnails.description:
The four most-recent media files added to the folder, in slot order
(the schema stores them as `maybe_last_media_file_token_1..4`).
Slots whose media file has been deleted are skipped, so the vec
may contain 0-4 entries.

oneOf.description:
User-chosen cover image. When present, the frontend should use this
as the folder's primary thumbnail instead of the
`last_media_thumbnails` grid.

FolderThumbnail.description:
A compact thumbnail descriptor for a media file referenced by a
folder (either one of the `last_media_*` slots or the custom cover).

Intentionally narrower than `MediaLinks` / `CoverImageLinks` — folders
only need the bare minimum to render a thumbnail card. The CDN URL is
the direct asset link; `maybe_thumbnail_template` carries the resizing
template URL (with `{{width}}` / `{{height}}` placeholders) when the
media class supports it.

cdn_url.description: Direct CDN URL to the underlying media asset.

maybe_thumbnail_template.description:
Resizing template URL (with `{{width}}` / `{{height}}` placeholders)
when the media class supports it. `None` for media classes without
a thumbnail variant. (Video media files instead have video previews,
which, in turn, have their own thumbnail templates.)

oneOf.description:
Video preview images (still and animated gif) for mp4 video files.
These are only set for video media files.

FolderThumbnailVideoPreviews.description:
Video preview images for a video media file referenced by a folder.
Mirrors the shape of `MediaLinks`' video previews, but is its own type
so the folder wire shape can evolve independently.

animated.description: An animated gif preview of the video.

animated_thumbnail_template.description:
A template used to construct the animated thumbnail URL.
Replace the string `{WIDTH}` with the desired width.

still.description: A static single frame preview image of the video.

still_thumbnail_template.description:
A template used to construct the still thumbnail URL.
Replace the string `{WIDTH}` with the desired width.

oneOf.description: If an alert is set, this might be a key for a common i18n message to show.

maybe_message.description:
We can set an optional message to show to the frontend.

This field may or may not be set. If it's set, this is custom text that should
be displayed to the user. For example, we might tell the user when we'll be
back online, etc. Both this field and `maybe_category` are optional.

If `maybe_category` is present, it should be a key for a predefined and
internationalized (i18n) message stored on the frontend.

Either or both of these fields may be set.

oneOf.description:
If there's an alert, this will be set.
The sub keys are optional, but at least one of them will be set.
i.e. we can have an alert with no message or no predefined category.

refresh_interval_millis.description:
Tell the frontend client how fast to refresh their view of this list.
During an attack, we may want this to go extremely slow.

TagDetails.description: One tag as returned by every tags endpoint.

tag_value.description: The display value of the tag, as entered by its creator.

tag_value_lowercase.description:
Lowercased form of `tag_value`. This is the tag's unique key
within the creator's account.

use_count.description: Rollup statistic: how many media files currently carry this tag.

get_folder_handler.summary: Fetch a single folder owned by the logged-in user.

list_folders_handler.summary:
List all live folders owned by the logged-in user. Newest first.
Includes the derived `is_orphaned` flag.

list_media_file_tags_handler.summary:
All tags on a media file, sorted by tag value. No login required for
public and hidden media files (anyone with the URL); PRIVATE files
only reveal their tags to their creator — everyone else gets a 404,
same as a nonexistent file, so private tag vocabulary doesn't leak.

list_tags_handler.summary: Paginated list of the logged-in user's tags, newest first.

parameters.description: Which provider's models to list. Defaults to "artcraft" if absent.
parameters.name: provider
